content.value_statement: Manual pull request preparation often misses review, test, and release checks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a structured Git workflow.
actual_capabilities: Coordinates code quality review before commit preparation.
Guides dependency, breaking change, and migration checks.
Structures test execution, coverage review, and test gap analysis.
Creates Conventional Commit guidance for one or more commits.
Prepares branch strategy, push readiness checks, and PR metadata.
Provides rollback steps for issues after merge.
limitations: It depends on available subagents or equivalent review and testing tools.
It does not guarantee that every repository policy is detected automatically.
It may need project-specific commands for tests, CI, and PR creation.
It is guidance for Git workflows, not a replacement for human approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare Feature Pull Requests
use_cases.description: Guide review, tests, commit messages, branch checks, and PR details before opening a feature request.

use_cases.title: Validate Release Readiness
use_cases.description: Check breaking changes, deployment notes, branch protection needs, and rollback plans before merging.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflow
use_cases.description: Apply one repeatable process for Conventional Commits, test evidence, PR metadata, and reviewer handoff.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Changes
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a normal feature branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my uncommitted changes and prepare a pull request for main.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Conventional Commits
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow when commit quality matters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with the conventional commit path. Recommend atomic commits, messages, and required test evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Draft PR Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for work that needs early review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with draft PR guidance. Include review findings, test gaps, deployment notes, and reviewer metadata.

prompt_templates.title: Run Release Readiness Checks
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for risky or production-facing changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill for a release-ready PR. Include breaking change analysis, branch strategy, CI readiness, and rollback procedures.

output_examples.input: A developer has finished a bug fix and wants a clean PR.
output: A review summary with blockers and follow-up items.
A test evidence checklist with any missing coverage.
A Conventional Commit recommendation and PR description outline.

output_examples.input: A team is merging a change that may affect production behavior.
output: A breaking change assessment and deployment notes.
A branch and push readiness checklist.
A rollback plan with revert, feature flag, hotfix, and communication steps.

best_practices: Run review and test phases before preparing commits or PR metadata.
Keep PRs small enough for effective review and clear ownership.
Record test results, deployment notes, and rollback steps in the PR.
anti_patterns: Skipping tests for convenience without documenting the reason.
Combining unrelated changes into one large pull request.
Opening a PR without checking secrets, CI readiness, or branch protection.

faq.question: Does this skill run Git commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and command recommendations that should be reviewed before use.

faq.question: Can it create a pull request description?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides creation of a structured PR description with testing, deployment, and review details.

faq.question: Does it support both trunk-based and feature branch workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes guidance for trunk-based development and feature branch workflows.

faq.question: Can it help with Conventional Commits?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes steps to categorize changes and prepare Conventional Commit messages.

faq.question: What tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code with access to code review and testing workflows.

faq.question: Is it suitable for high-risk production changes?
faq.answer: Yes, when paired with project-specific tests, CI checks, required approvals, and human review.
